messages.title: Day 1 of 8: leave the car at home today
messages.body: Plan a trip without driving today. Rider guides can help. Describe your trip in My week to enter. A post is optional.
messages.text: Week Without Driving day 1: Plan one trip without driving, then describe it in My week: {link} Reply STOP to end.

messages.title: Day 2 of 8: leave the car at home today
messages.body: Describe a trip without driving in My week today. You can also mark a Bingo square; some squares can be done at home.
messages.text: Week Without Driving day 2: Describe your trip in My week and mark a Bingo square: {link} Reply STOP to end.

messages.title: Day 3 of 8: leave the car at home today
messages.body: Try a trip to a library, park or market. Find a bus can help you plan it, and you can describe the trip in My week.
messages.text: Week Without Driving day 3: Go somewhere new and describe your trip in My week: {link} Reply STOP to end.

messages.title: Day 4 of 8: leave the car at home today
messages.body: Describe your trip in My week. If a missing curb ramp, long wait or hot stop made it hard, tell us in the separate optional question.
messages.text: Week Without Driving day 4: Describe your trip in My week. What was hard is optional: {link} Reply STOP to end.

messages.title: Day 5 of 8: leave the car at home today
messages.body: Find a stop near home, work or school, then describe a trip without driving in My week.
messages.text: Week Without Driving day 5: Find a stop near you, then describe your trip in My week: {link} Reply STOP to end.

messages.title: Day 6 of 8: leave the car at home today
messages.body: Describe your trip in My week. If you want to share it with friends, My week can make a picture for your post.
messages.text: Week Without Driving day 6: Describe your trip in My week. A post is optional: {link} Reply STOP to end.

messages.title: Day 7 of 8: leave the car at home today
messages.body: Talk to someone who does not drive about how they get around. It is also a Bingo square. Describe your own trip in My week.
messages.text: Week Without Driving day 7: Talk to a nondriver, then describe your trip in My week: {link} Reply STOP to end.

messages.title: Day 8 of 8: last day! Leave the car at home
messages.body: Last day: take a trip without driving. Describe your trip in My week to enter. A post is optional.
messages.text: Week Without Driving day 8: Last day! Describe your trip in My week, then keep going: {link} Reply STOP to end.
